title: Prove the first central Schur state collision at pivot size four (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas.

```text
same complete central class Z=(S+T)^2
    does not imply the same ordered Schur state
first collision: pivot 4, residual 14, ambient 18
```

In the sharp nilpotent identity-pivot family over every characteristic-two field, the same original profile `(4,4,4,6)` admits compressed products `J3(0)+J1(0)` and `J2(0)+J2(0)`. Both central operators have Jordan form `J2(0)^4+J1(0)^6`, but `rank((S+T)^3)` is two versus zero. A complete central-class key therefore cannot deduplicate these ordered states. The dimensions are minimal within the stated same-pivot, same-profile nilpotent family.

Credit Malik Safwan / ssafwann #5267 for the nilpotent model and whole-pair rigidity, Ali Romman #5287 for the complete characteristic-two central law, and Mihir Srivastava #5360 for the general ordered gluing boundary. The package retains the wider Schur lineage. These are cited premises; their scientific suites were not replayed as this deliverable. The new contribution is the minimal collision, explicit original headers and ordered-state separator.

[CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19540664). Six new files in `research/schur-central-alias/`; no selected-frontier file changes.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the central law and whole-pair normal forms were available, without this minimal same-profile alias.
- **After:** a written proof, two literal 18-dimensional original headers and 14-dimensional residual pairs, an explicit invertible central intertwiner, all eleven partitions through pivot size four and all fourteen same-size unordered comparisons. Exactly the displayed partition pair collides. Eight rejection/separation controls pass.
- Warning-strict ordinary and optimized direct checks return `PASS_SCHUR_CENTRAL_ALIAS`, with identical computed hash-bound receipts. Local durations were 0.0292 and 0.0291 seconds. Both registered commands pass; the package runner took 0.313 seconds and returned `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
- Metadata/pins and committed-byte, executable-mode and declared-source-history checks pass at `02f0ffab916042785f0a61ebfc4dacb9495a0ac2`. Source compilation and whitespace checks pass. CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. These durations are check runtimes, not performance claims.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/schur-central-alias/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/schur-central-alias/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-central-alias
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/schur-central-alias --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. The direct verifier writes no files and computes its receipt from the literal evidence and source hashes.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal minimum relies on the written proof and cited normal-form rigidity. It is scoped to sharp nilpotent identity pivots at the same pivot size and ordered original profile. It is not a universal minimum for arbitrary idempotent pairs. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

No new kappa, physical saving, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Physical access, coefficient preparation, movement, restoration, precision, stock, dispatch and a complete recursive invoice remain outside scope. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, Lean or Docker was run.

## Open next questions

- Specify an actual ordered-state registry and price acquisition of the full power-rank profile of `S+T`; the central class alone is insufficient.
- Under a separately named nonsharp or mixed-primary contract, find the first analogous alias. This PR holds no follow-on scope.

## Related open work

No open PR found on the same sharp nilpotent ordered-state equivalence question. Nearby Schur-rank work uses a different paired-star contract:

- #7006: partial F4 two-thin-map paired-star census; no ordered-state central equivalence claim.
- #7028: one nullity-seven paired-star class has rank sum at least eight; different matrices and invariant.
- #7049: a second nullity-seven paired-star class; different matrices and invariant.
- #7091: a nullity-32 paired-star Schur-rank lower bound; different matrices and invariant.
- #7134: odd-characteristic rectangular residual-rank floors; no nilpotent state-equivalence claim.

Their bodies were read; no extra computations were run to validate their results or compare unrelated numbers.

The closeout check read this account's eight other open PRs created since the CLAIM: #7203, #7204, #7206, #7207, #7208, #7210, #7211 and #7212. None studies sharp nilpotent ordered Schur-state equivalence or computes the central-alias minimum here. No new related-work line or numerical comparison is required.

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found
```
